description: SPENDS CREDITS: quote_outreach first, show the price to the user and after their yes pass its `credits` as confirm_credits. Needs the sender ready, the essence and the accounts. Runs in the background (minutes); poll get_outreach every 30-60 s. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/outreach/start]

cids.description: Fit people (cid) of the search; get_outreach lists them.

confirm_credits.description: The price in credits the matching quote returned, shown to the user and confirmed by them.

generation_id.description: The outreach generation id (get_outreach campaign.generation.id); omitted: the current one.

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

name: start_outreach
title: Write the messages (spends credits)
